import ctypes
from ctypes import c_size_t, POINTER

# Load the dynamic libraries
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_matrix structure
class GSLMatrix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size1", c_size_t),
        ("size2", c_size_t),
        ("tda", c_size_t),
        ("data", POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

# Define the gsl_matrix_alloc function
libgsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = POINTER(GSLMatrix)
libgsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.argtypes = [c_size_t, c_size_t]

def allocate_matrix(n1, n2):
    """Allocate a matrix of size n1 x n2 using gsl_matrix_alloc."""
    matrix_ptr = libgsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(n1, n2)
    if not matrix_ptr:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate matrix.")
    return matrix_ptr

def assert_test():
    """Test cases to validate the allocate_matrix function."""
    # Test case 1: Allocate a 3x3 matrix
    matrix = allocate_matrix(3, 3)
    assert matrix.contents.size1 == 3, "Matrix size1 should be 3."
    assert matrix.contents.size2 == 3, "Matrix size2 should be 3."

    # Test case 2: Allocate a 5x2 matrix
    matrix = allocate_matrix(5, 2)
    assert matrix.contents.size1 == 5, "Matrix size1 should be 5."
    assert matrix.contents.size2 == 2, "Matrix size2 should be 2."

    # Test case 3: Allocate a 0x0 matrix (edge case)
    matrix = allocate_matrix(0, 0)
    assert matrix.contents.size1 == 0, "Matrix size1 should be 0."
    assert matrix.contents.size2 == 0, "Matrix size2 should be 0."

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
